metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Partners In Health EMR and informatics work

plugins.name: ocl
plugins.description: Search and maintain the PIH concept dictionary in Open Concept Lab (OCL): look up concepts, check set membership, clone from CIEL, and create or edit PIH concepts and mappings.

plugins.name: openmrs
plugins.description: Rules for working in OpenMRS core and the shared core modules: keep shared code generic and FHIR-based, avoid breaking changes, follow the OpenMRS and Bahmni contribution process, and backport and release the way PIH needs, and check code and PR reviews against known OpenMRS mistakes.
